items.name: narration_hi
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy geography countdown Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel, in natural spoken Hindi like a top Indian geography explainer channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who can't believe how wild this story is and can't wait to tell you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright and punchy, loud-ish and lively. Every 'Number five / four / three / two / one' is a big, punchy countdown call with a tiny pause after it, rising in hype toward number one. Hit every number with genuine amazement ('WOW' energy) and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. 'Or is it?' is playful and knowing. 'But the last two get weirder' is whispered-excited, leaning in like a secret. 'Banned too' is deadpan and funny. The last line trails off unfinished, voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Pace is quick and bouncy, about 175 words per minute, short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy, bored or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy level throughout. Numbers and English words (GTA, number five/four/three/two/one, country names, ban, banned, Sony, Xbox, PlayStation, game, license, police, gaming clubs, raids, announce, Counter-Strike) are spoken in English, naturally, the way Indian creators mix them. Say GTA as the letters G-T-A. Pronounce Tajikistan as tah-JEE-kih-stan, Qatar as KAH-tar, Bahrain as bah-RAIN, Oman as oh-MAHN.
lines: GTA 6 इन five देशों में BANNED है... या नहीं?
क्योंकि सच में बस एक ने किया।
Number five: Saudi Arabia और UAE.
इन्होंने GTA 5 को twelve साल तक रोका...
...फिर twenty twenty-five में ban खत्म। GTA 6? बिक रहा है!
कोई ban नहीं... Sony और Xbox ने वहां बेचना ही बंद कर दिया।
हर विदेशी game को सरकारी license चाहिए... GTA 6 के पास नहीं है।
लेकिन आखिरी दो और भी अजीब हैं।
Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman... ये तो PlayStation पर भी नहीं है।
कोई ban announce नहीं... बस गायब है।
Twenty twenty-four में सरकार ने हर GTA game ban कर दिया।
Police ने तो gaming clubs पर raids तक announce कर दिए!
तो... आपको सबसे ज़्यादा किसने चौंकाया? क्योंकि सच बताऊं...
